question: Should this umbrella remain open for the Linux companion app now that Windows Hub is documented and released, or should maintainers split Linux into a narrower canonical issue and close this broader request?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 cover Windows Hub, but current docs still state there is no native Linux companion app, and choosing GTK/C, Tauri, or another desktop architecture is a maintainer product/security ownership decision.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical platform-app tracker while maintainers choose or land the Linux companion direction and preserve the Windows Hub context.

options.title: Split Linux only
options.body: Create or designate a narrower Linux companion app tracker, link it here, and close this broader item once the Windows Hub half is considered complete.

recommendation.title: Keep as umbrella
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical platform-app tracker while maintainers choose or land the Linux companion direction and preserve the Windows Hub context.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue and discussion show steipete setting the platform app product direction, and recent docs history ties him to the Windows/Linux status pages.
